title: BINI earns historic win at Nickelodeon Kids’ Choice Awards, beating Taylor Swift

blocks.text: Filipino girl group BINI has made history after winning Favorite Global Music Star at the 2026 Nickelodeon Kids’ Choice Awards, besting international music stars including Taylor Swift, Tyla and Karol G. The Nation’s Girl Group represented Asia in the global category, competing against Tyla (Africa), Zara Larsson (Europe), Taylor Swift (North America), Olivia Dean (United Kingdom), Karol G (Latin America), and Tame Impala (Australia). The win marks another milestone for the eight-member group as they became the first Filipino act and the first non-Korean representative to earn a win and nomination in the category.
